name: Radar
tagline: Location platform for geofencing, tracking, and place search
description: Radar is a location infrastructure platform that provides APIs for geofencing, continuous location tracking, reverse geocoding, place search, distance/matrix routing, and trip tracking. Developers integrate Radar into mobile and web apps for location-based features without building their own location stack.

auth.details: Publishable and secret API keys sent via Authorization: Bearer or Authorization: prj_live_pk_... header patterns; secret keys for server-side only.

use_cases: forward geocode an address to coordinates
reverse geocode lat/lng to an address
